description: [LLM-Judge] Unsigned OIDC request object (alg=none) appears accepted (HTTP 200) even though the client was not successfully created/updated, so the test likely hit a non-enforcing endpoint or default realm behavior and cannot demonstrate rejection.

sequence_description: I1 direct-endpoint with config change + re-auth: Create a client, then change client config and re-test alg=none request object acceptance. If accepted in either state, Keycloak consumed an unsigned request object without authenticity checks.
description: [LLM-Judge] Request object test returned HTTP 200 ("accepted") even though the client creation failed and the client cannot be found, suggesting the test may be hitting a non-enforcing endpoint or misinterpreting 200 as successful authorization.
